title: Prelude Map Schema
description: Schema for Prelude map.json: a deterministic routing index of a codebase's modules, files, exports, and internal import graph. Pointers, not truth: it tells an agent where to look.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema for this file

version.description: Semantic version of the map format

unresolvedImports.description: Internal-looking imports that could not be resolved to a file

truncated.description: True when the file cap was hit

modules.description: Directories that group source files, sorted by path. A module path is a directory truncated to at most three segments; '.' holds root-level files.

path.description: Module directory relative to the project root

purpose.description: Short phrase describing what the module is for. Inferred from the directory name or its exports; a hand-edited purpose is preserved by prelude update.

notes.description: Free-form notes written by a human or agent. Never inferred; always preserved.

fileCount.description: Number of source files in the module before any cap

truncated.description: True when files[] was capped to the highest-ranked files

files.description: Source files in the module, sorted by path

file.description: File path relative to the project root, forward slashes

exports.description: Exported names in order of first appearance (max 40)

imports.description: Resolved internal import targets. Go package targets end with '/'.

importedBy.description: Number of non-test files that import this file (in-degree)

rank.description: Importance from 0 to 1: in-degree divided by the maximum in-degree, with a 0.5 floor for declared entry points and key files

role.description: Role copied from architecture.json entryPoints or keyFiles

dependsOn.description: Other modules that this module's non-test files import from

dependedOnBy.description: Other modules whose non-test files import from this module

tests.description: Test files whose imports resolve into this module

hubs.description: The most-imported files, sorted by importedBy then path (max 15). Read these first in an unfamiliar codebase.

importedBy.description: Number of non-test files that import this file
